ECOSYSTEM FOUNDATION

Device-specific drivers, shared platform

MechKeyMesh is structured as a multi-vendor platform. The AULA F108 Pro is the first complete implementation and validation target. Future keyboards add independent drivers and data-driven layouts instead of keyboard-specific UI code.

ASSIGN ACTION

Normal-layer action

Only F108 encodings supported by current protocol evidence are enabled.

Modifiers

The macro ID is stored here; its stable F108 bank slot is resolved immediately before the keymap write.

Open application, file, URL and send-text assignments in the OEM software depend on an indexed host-side handler. They stay disabled until MechKeyMesh verifies that event channel rather than pretending the four-byte mapping alone is sufficient.
Reset semantics

Reset selected restores only the selected assignments to firmware default in the editor.

Reset current layer stores and sends an empty remap table for Normal or Fn.

Reset key assignments clears both remap tables only. It is intentionally not called "Reset Keyboard" or "Factory Reset". Those broader OEM operations remain unavailable until their exact physical scope is verified.

AULA F108 PRO

Knob actions

Firmware controls

Use the physical knob for these actions. On the reference firmware, select the clock or GIF screen and press Fn + knob to lock that screen and enable volume control.

ActionVolume controlLCD menus
Turn clockwiseVolume upNavigate / adjust value
Turn counterclockwiseVolume downNavigate / adjust value
Press knobMute / unmuteSelect menu item

These actions are documented for reference firmware. MechKeyMesh cannot read the selected knob mode; confirm the behavior on your keyboard.

CUSTOM ASSIGNMENTS

Knob remapping

Unavailable

The F108 Pro knob is outside the key remapping table. The reference driver has no verified command to change its turn or press assignments.

Knob navigation in the LCD menus is handled by keyboard firmware.

WINDOWS INTEGRATION · R19

Keep MechKeyMesh in the background

Right-click the tray icon to select a profile, pause or resume effects, reconnect, or exit. Left-click it to reopen the window. Selecting a profile in the tray turns automatic switching off until you enable it again.

Loading background status...

Startup with Windows is disabled unless you choose it.

Sleep cancels hardware I/O and stops streams. Wake redetects the keyboard and reconciles the active profile. A cancelled LCD transfer is never silently resumed or applied.
